conditions.rule: Check for urgent risks in the mentally ill patient needing treatment or admission
conditions.note: Trigger: the box header's presenting complaint. Mental disorder is not a common symptom or warning sign and no rule diagnoses it at probable, so the clinical_finding form is used in both trigger and priority rule.

conditions.rule: Check for urgent risks in the mentally ill patient needing treatment or admission
conditions.expr: (finding (snomed_concept "Clinical finding" "finding") (snomed_concept "At increased risk of self-injurious behavior" "finding"))
conditions.quote: Patient inflicting serious harm to self
conditions.note: Page is about risk ('may lead to ... causing'); a risk finding fits better than an event of harm. Concept already in VHA vocabulary. Alt: At increased risk for deliberate self harm.
